standard_challenges.title: Mode of Transit
standard_challenges.description: Use different forms of Milan public transport at stops or stations physically inside the active NIL. A transit mode counts when the team boards or gets off that transit mode at a stop/station within the NIL.
standard_challenges.proof: A single stop within an NIL may only be used once per transit mode. For Metro or rail, the station exit used must be inside the NIL.

standard_challenges.title: Enjoy a Park
standard_challenges.description: Spend continuous time relaxing, playing, walking, sitting, or otherwise enjoying a park or garden in the active NIL. The place must be labelled or categorised as a park or garden on Google Maps.
standard_challenges.proof: Send a photo of the team in the park at the start and end of the timed period. This can be completed while the team is on its normal 30-minute lunch break.

standard_challenges.title: Giro di Piazza
standard_challenges.description: Find distinct piazze or piazzette in the active NIL that are named after a real person who is primarily known for accomplishments in one of these categories. The location must be labelled as a Piazza or Piazzetta on Google Maps.

levels.label: Level 1
levels.requirement: Find and take a photo of 1 piazza/piazzetta.

levels.label: Level 2
levels.requirement: Find and take a photo of 2 piazze/piazzette.

levels.label: Level 3
levels.requirement: Find and take a photo of 3 piazze/piazzette.

levels.label: Extreme
levels.requirement: Find and take a photo of 4 piazze/piazzette.

standard_challenges.proof: Send a photo of the team at each qualifying piazza/piazzetta, showing the place or its sign/name where practical. Each piazza/piazzetta may count only once.
standard_challenges.reference_label: Giro di Piazza — OSM Candidate Map

standard_challenges.title: Milan 2026 Olympic Mini Games
standard_challenges.description: Create your own Winter Games! Complete different events from the list below while inside the active NIL. Each event may count only once toward the challenge. Team members may divide the events between themselves unless an event specifically requires both players.
items: Curling: On a reasonably smooth paved surface, slide a coin or bottle cap from behind a marked starting line. It must travel at least 3 metres and come to rest no more than 1 metre to either side of its original direction of travel.

Biathlon: Briskly walk at least 30 metres, then immediately make a successful throw of a soft or harmless object into a bag, container, or clearly marked target from at least 2 metres away. Running is not permitted.

Ski Jumping: Make a small paper “ski jumper,” such as a folded paper football or similar paper creation. Launch it through the air so that it travels at least 2 metres before first touching the ground. The launch must take place in a safe open area and must not be directed toward other people, roads, tracks, or moving vehicles.
Ski Mountaineering: Climb at least 30 public steps in one continuous ascent, walking normally.

Luge: Find a safe slope or ramp, away from traffic. Release a small object and allow gravity to carry it at least 8 metres without the object being pushed, kicked, or touched again by the team after release. A teammate must remain in a safe position to retrieve or stop the object, and the course must not cross roads, cycle paths, active stairs, or other busy pedestrian routes.

Hockey Shoot-Out: On a smooth surface, create a goal approximately 30 cm wide using two markers. From at least 2 metres away, the two teammates take turns attempting to slide the coin or bottle cap into the goal. Each player takes 7 shots. The player who scores the most goals wins the shoot-out. If the score is tied after seven shots each, continue with sudden-death shots until there is a winner.
standard_challenges.proof: Different events may take place at the same or different locations within the active NIL. All events must be completed entirely within the active NIL.

standard_challenges.title: Fiat Finder
standard_challenges.description: Italy’s best-selling car is the Fiat Panda. Find parked Fiat Pandas in the active NIL in different qualifying colours. The Panda may be from any generation, but must clearly be identifiable as a Fiat Panda.
standard_challenges.proof: Send a photo clearly showing each Panda and its colour. If you are unsure about the colour, consult the reference guide and ask the group chat for a ruling. The car must be parked and in a public area. Do not photograph number plates more closely than necessary.

standard_challenges.title: Old Time Religion
standard_challenges.description: Find an old church in the active NIL that appears under a qualifying century heading in the Italian Wikipedia list “Chiese di Milano” under “Elenco chiese”.
standard_challenges.proof: “secolo” means century and Roman numerals are used. Send a photo of your team at the church. The church must be physically located within the active NIL and must appear in the qualifying century section of the Wikipedia list.

standard_challenges.title: Milano Scavenger Hunt
standard_challenges.description: Explore the active NIL and find different things from the Milano Scavenger Hunt list below. Each category may count only once toward the challenge. The same physical object cannot be used for two different categories.
items: The Comune di Milano coat of arms or logo
An ATM tram, bus or trolleybus stop sign
A public statue, monument or sculpture
A mural or piece of street art
Somewhere visibly selling or advertising panettone
standard_challenges.proof: Send photographs showing each qualifying item. The photographs must make it reasonably clear what the item is and that it was found within the active NIL.

standard_challenges.title: Milanese Derby
standard_challenges.description: Before starting, choose either AC Milan or Inter Milan as your chosen team. Find visible items supporting or identifying the chosen club at different locations within the active NIL. The same shop/building/location can count only once.
standard_challenges.proof: Official club stores, the San Siro stadium/club museum complex, and repeated items inside one dedicated football-merchandise shop do not count. Send a photo of each qualifying item/location.

special_challenges.title: Walking Tour
special_challenges.description: Walking Tour is the universal wildcard and is not assigned to a NIL. A qualifying street is a named public street, road, lane, or pedestrian street shown on Google Maps. To count a street, walk one continuous qualifying portion entirely within the active NIL. The portion ends at the NIL boundary, the physical beginning/end or dead end, a name change, or a clear split into a differently named street. Ordinary intersections do not end a street if the same name continues. If the portion is 300 metres or less, walk the whole portion; if longer, any continuous 300-metre section within the NIL qualifies. Each named street may count only once.
special_challenges.proof: There is no Extreme Walking Tour level. The entire qualifying walk must take place on foot and within the active NIL. Crossing an ordinary intersection does not interrupt a street if the same street name continues on the other side.

special_challenges.title: Have Lunch
special_challenges.description: Spend at least 45 continuous minutes enjoying a proper lunch in the active NIL. It may not be started before 11:00 Saturday and may not be completed after 15:00. Completing it satisfies the team’s mandatory Saturday lunch break. Each team may successfully complete Have Lunch only once.
special_challenges.proof: Send a photo of the team enjoying lunch.
